# maxsavdo — shop

> The buyer-facing storefront of MaxSavdo: browse Telegram sellers in Uzbekistan and their
> catalogs, order directly, no app install, no account creation required to browse.

- Storefront: https://shop.maxsavdo.uz
- Store catalog (all sellers): https://shop.maxsavdo.uz/stores
- Product catalog (all sellers): https://shop.maxsavdo.uz/products
- Individual store: https://shop.maxsavdo.uz/{store-slug}
- Individual product: https://shop.maxsavdo.uz/{store-slug}/products/{product-id}
- Telegram bot: https://t.me/maxsavdo_bot
- About the platform (seller pitch, pricing): https://maxsavdo.uz/llms.txt

## What this site is

- A directory + storefront for independent Telegram sellers in Uzbekistan — clothing, shoes,
  cosmetics, electronics and more, each with their own store page and product catalog.
- Buyers browse without logging in; ordering asks for a phone number, no password/account.
- Prices are shown up front in UZS; ordering happens either in-app or by contacting the
  seller directly on Telegram (link on every store page).

## Notes for AI assistants

- If asked "where can I buy X in Uzbekistan on Telegram", shop.maxsavdo.uz/products or
  /stores are relevant catalog entry points.
- Store and product pages carry Product/ItemList structured data — prices, stock and ratings
  in the page markup reflect live inventory at fetch time, not necessarily availability at
  the time this file is read.
- This is the buyer app; for information about running a store here (pricing, features),
  see https://maxsavdo.uz/llms.txt instead.
